facts.text: Snow left Lost Horse (5,100 ft) 24 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Lost Horse
evidence.detail: left April 7; earlier seasons: May 12 (2023), May 1 (2024), April 27 (2025)

facts.text: At Lost Horse (5,100 ft), this year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was 4.4 in, the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026).

evidence.name: Lost Horse
evidence.detail: 4.4 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 21.1 in (2023), 10.3 in (2024), 15.3 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between January 26 and April 9, carried from the melt-out date at Lost Horse (5,100 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Lost Horse
evidence.detail: melted out April 7, 1,993 ft above the pass; points to January 26 to April 9
